modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: two overlapping objects in front view cut by a diagonal line

readings.meaning: audio output disabled / no sound devices
quiet zone / no loud audio or headphones allowed

ambiguity: At small sizes the slashed speaker box and headphones break into disconnected strokes that resemble a broken document, a slashed padlock, or an unreadable abstract symbol.

reasoning: The icon combines a rectangular speaker box and over-ear headphones crossed out by a diagonal slash, representing disabled or disconnected audio output devices. Because the slash breaks up two already compact shapes, the glyph is visually cluttered at list size and only fits a narrow set of audio-troubleshooting or device-disabling tasks.
